Title: Manage your Azure Websites directly with Websites Process Explorer

Body.Content: Use Process Explorer to manage your website processes, and you'll be able to enumerate different instances of your site, browse processes for each instance, and drill down and view the handles and modules associated with each process. You'll also get get rich monitoring of the CPU, Working Set, and Thread count at the process level to help you identify runaway processes, find open file handles, and even kill a specific process instance.
